North Carolina FreeEnterprise Foundation (NCFREE) Results: NC State Board of Elections election results media file (results_pct), read directly from dl.ncsbe.gov and checked every minute. Unofficial until certified. How reporting is counted: a precinct counts as reported once NCSBE posts its Election Day votes. Early and mail votes are posted separately and can arrive before any precinct. County and district totals include every vote method and the administrative precincts (early voting, absentee, provisional, transfer); precinct tables show Election Day votes only. Incumbents are the 2024 winners of each seat in NCSBE results, updated for members appointed since. Precinct boundaries: NCSBE precinct shapefile, Aug. 24, 2026. District maps: S.L. 2025-95 (U.S. House), S.L. 2023-146 (NC Senate), S.L. 2023-149 (NC House). Spot a possible error, or have a question about how the tracker is built? Contact Brendan Higgins at brendan@ncfree.org.
